name: Stolen Realm Survivors
description:
About This Game

HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE THE STOLEN REALM?

Stolen Realm Survivors is an online co-op survivors-like auto-shooter set in the world of Stolen Realm. Battle relentless hordes, collect powerful artifacts, modify unique skills, and unleash devastating combos as the chaos escalates. Play solo or with friends and push your build as far as it can go before the onslaught overwhelms you.

REVERSE BULLET HELL, PURE BUILD CRAFTING

Your character attacks automatically; survival is up to you.

Dodge through swarming enemies, position carefully, and make smart upgrade choices as the screen fills with chaos. Combine skills, artifacts, and passives to create wildly different builds each run, from precise spellcasters to screen-clearing powerhouses. Every choice matters. Every run is different.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN

Defeat enemies, complete quests, and take on dangerous events to earn powerful rewards. Level up, collect loot, and modify diverse skills to shape your playstyle on the fly.

Push deeper into the Realm to face tougher enemies, deadlier encounters, and greater rewards. The longer you survive, the more absurdly powerful your build can become.

DYNAMIC QUESTS & BRANCHING PATHS

Encounter story driven events that twist your run in unexpected ways. Take on quests with objectives like survival challenges, kill counts, protection missions, and resource collection: each offering powerful, build defining rewards.

Navigate a branching map where every choice reshapes your journey. Choose your path through escalating battles, quests, shops, shrines, treasure, and bosses. In co op, vote with your party to decide your fate and adapt your strategy as the Realm shifts around you.

ONLINE CO-OP SURVIVAL

Survive alone or team up with friends in online co-op. Coordinate movement, builds, and upgrades to withstand overwhelming odds as a team. Whether you’re playing carefully or embracing total chaos, survival is always better with allies at your side.

THE STOLEN REALM, REIMAGINED

Explore the Stolen Realm from a top-down perspective built for nonstop survivors-like action as you escape the ominous halls of Castle Gloom. Experience the Realm in a fast, chaotic, and replayable new way.

The Realm is relentless. How long will you last?

COMMUNITY WISDOM

“I only planned to play one run. I haven’t seen sunlight since.” - Probably Someone
short_desc: An online co-op survivor-like auto-shooter set in the world of Stolen Realm. Battle relentless hordes of enemies, discover powerful artifacts, modify unique skills, and build unstoppable combos to survive. Play solo or with friends and unleash the full power of the Realm.
